Change of target states the block is successful, so yes, hells fury
applies.

Quoting the relevant card texts, preferably from the csv or card text
page, makes getting an answer a lot simpler and easier.

Unleash Hell's Fury
Type: Action
Requires: infernal Daimoinon
Cost: 2 pool
+1 stealth action. Requires an infernal vampire. Unique.
[dai] Put this card in play. This card may attempt to block a (D)
action against you and is considered a 9-capacity infernal vampire
with +2 intercept during that attempt; if successful, the acting
minion takes 1 unpreventable aggravated damage, and this card is
burned.
[DAI] As above, and untap this vampire. Burn option.

Change of Target
Type: Action Modifier
Only usable when this acting minion is blocked (play before combat, if
any). Untap the acting minion, do not tap the blocking minion, and end
the current action (it is not successful). This minion cannot perform
the same action again this turn.

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:


The wording suggests that Unleash doesn't care if there is an action
currently happening. If the action was blocked, it triggers and just
waits for other things to finish before pinging with the aggravated
damage.

Messages.Author: LSJ



The acting minion takes 1 aggravated damage. Even if the action is
ended by CoT.
The damage is inflicted during the action, as the action is ending.

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:


So to clearly delineate the steps:

Minion A takes an Action
Unleash Hell's Fury successfully blocks
Minion A plays Change of Target
Minion A takes 1 agg damage
Change of Target cancels the action, etc, etc, etc.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Change of Target ends the action, it doesn't cancel the action.

Minion A plays CoT.
CoT resolves when played, so the action is ending.
A takes 1 agg damage as the action is ending (mandatory).
